title: Apexspace wordmark
description: A plain, wide-tracked, bold all-caps wordmark in the theme's display grotesk, as the header and footer use it.
notes: text only: swap in your own logo by passing a different component where it is used
name: apexspace-wordmark

props.name: name
props.description: the brand name, set in wide bold capitals

props.name: href
props.description: link target (usually the home page); leave out for a plain mark

props.name: size
props.description: larger mark, as in the footer
